sections.heading: Draft interpretation
sections.text: The writer suggests that the closed valve indication proves hydraulic isolation and that the installed keeper should have prevented all movement. The writer therefore suspects excess clearance.

sections.heading: Basis and status
sections.text: This note cites only the initial event notice and handle-status entry. It contains no leak measurement, retention-envelope calculation or independent witness account. Status: unreviewed interpretation, not an additional observation.

sections.heading: Source lineage
